{{Quote|If they've brought Dropships, they're prepared to fight!|Unidentified [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenant]] at the First Battle of Lok|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Trade Federation Dropship''' was a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Dropship/Legends|Dropship]] was a long craft, about the length of a [[Trade Federation Superfreighter]]. The Dropship was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] but lacked armament.

==Role==
Dropships were used by the Trade Federation to deliver [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|its forces]] to battlefields. Dropships were used individually, in groups, or alongside larger [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. Dropships could deploy tanks, [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|infantry]], or a combination of both. A common tactic used against Dropships was to destroy them before they could deploy any forces.

==History==
Trade Federation Dropships were sent to [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to ensure the retrieval of [[Pirate/Legends|pirated]] cargo and later as part of the [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|assault]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|pirates']] [[Nym's Base|base]]. During that same year, the Trade Federation utilized these ships several times during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] against forces resistant to the occupation. Several Dropships were aboard the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']] when it was destroyed in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Space Battle]].

Ten years later, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a large number of Dropships were deployed to protect a [[trihexalon]] factory during the [[Battle of Nod Kartha]]. Not long after, three Dropships were refueling at [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] when the pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] came to [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|reclaim]] his base.

==Behind the scenes==
The dropship is very similar in appearance to a concept drawing of what would become the C-9979 found in ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]'', where it is deploying early concept versions of the [[Multi-Troop Transport]].
